evidence.input_validation: Complete finite C-MAPSS schema, one engine, ordered contiguous cycles; dataset matches the selected original predictor.
evidence.interpretation_boundary: A real fitted-model result on a simulated turbofan, not evidence of a fault in a photographed real component.

evidence.excerpt: Photographs can support visible observations. They cannot prove internal damage or supply a sensor-based RUL estimate. A real component photograph and a NASA simulated engine are unrelated evidence sources unless an independently validated relationship exists.
Provenance: project-authored integration notes derived from the existing SIRE README and Phase A inference contracts. This is software documentation, not an equipment maintenance manual.

The saved predictors require dataset-matched C-MAPSS histories with engine unit, cycle, three operating settings and twenty-one sensors. Fitted preprocessing is loaded from the original training artifacts. Generic vibration or vehicle CSV files are not compatible merely because they contain numeric readings.
